summary: Frontend-only validation of the accountant/office panel and business↔accountant linking flow. All primary flows work end-to-end: (1) /register account-type chooser renders both cards; business → /register?type=business form; accountant → /accountant-signup form. (2) Business owner /settings?tab=accountant renders the Λογιστής tab with accountant-code-generate (produced code 948730), accountant-code-value shown, accountant-invite-email/level/btn, active-link accountant-level-<id> select + accountant-unlink-<id>; changing the access level to μόνο ανάγνωση persisted (server action returned success, badge updated). (3) Accountant office@koletsas.gr logs in and is redirected to /office; /office/clients renders tab-code/tab-afm/tab-how plus link-code-input/link-code-submit and the pending AFM request row (ANYHOW ΙΚΕ) with cancel button. (4) /office/clients/<orgId> Client 360 renders client360-kpis for a linked org and returns HTTP 404 for a non-linked UUID. (5) /office/vat renders vat-month-input, vat-bulk-transmit, vat-table, vat-row-<orgId>, vat-select-<orgId>; the bulk-books export button is present under data-testid="vat-bulk-export" (NAMING DEVIATION vs the review request which asked for vat-bulk-books). (6) /office/team: staff-email-input, staff-role-select, staff-invite-btn all present. (7) /office/fees: after login and hydration a fee-row-<orgId> is rendered with fee-amount-<orgId>, fee-cadence-<orgId>, fee-note-<orgId>, fee-save-<orgId> plus a global fees-generate-btn (NAMING DEVIATION vs the review request which listed fee-amount/fee-cadence/fee-save without an org-id suffix). (8) /office/inbox exposes inbox-list. (9) /office/assistant: assistant-run triggers POST /api/copilot/office-brief; a full Greek response arrived in ~25s with a Σύνοψη block, 6 Ενέργειες σήμερα with severity badges (high/medium/low) and per-client sections — LLM key is healthy. (10) Regression: /dashboard, /settings?tab=users (no 'accountant' role in role dropdown), /office/cockpit, /office/tasks, /office/calendar, /office/documents all return 200 and render. No 500 responses, no red console errors (only one benign 404 for the intentionally invalid org UUID and a React 'script tag while rendering' warning surfaced by the Emergent overlay, not app code).

integration_issues.issue: office@koletsas.gr is already actively linked to demo@timologio.gr (via prior AFM request), so a fresh business→accountant invite cannot be delivered to that account to test [data-testid^=org-invite-accept-]. The receiving-side UI IS wired (accountant /office/clients maps firmLinkInvites and renders org-invite-accept-<id> when status='pending'), but this iteration observed 0 such rows because none exist. Recommend either seeding a second accountant org OR unlinking Δήμος↔Κολέτσας in seed data so QA can exercise the accept/decline path.

Two documented selectors do not match the actual DOM: (a) VAT bulk-books CSV export is exposed as data-testid="vat-bulk-export" (not vat-bulk-books); (b) Fees per-client Save/Amount/Cadence are exposed per-orgId (fee-amount-<orgId>, fee-cadence-<orgId>, fee-save-<orgId>, fee-note-<orgId>) rather than the bare fee-amount/fee-cadence/fee-save listed in the review request. Functionality works — this is a docs/selector alignment gap only.

verified_features: /register: register-type-chooser + register-type-business (→ business form) + register-type-accountant (→ /accountant-signup) all wired.

Business /settings?tab=accountant: accountant-code-generate produced code '948730'; accountant-code-value displays it; invite form + active-link row expose accountant-invite-email/level/btn and accountant-level-<id> + accountant-unlink-<id>; changing access level to μόνο ανάγνωση persists.

Accountant office@koletsas.gr redirects to /office post-login; office-nav shows Επισκόπηση/Ειδοποιήσεις/AI Βοηθός/Πελάτες/ΦΠΑ & myDATA/Κίνδυνοι & μαζικές/Ημερολόγιο/Εκκρεμότητες/Παραγωγικότητα/Έγγραφα/Ομάδα/Αμοιβές/Έξοδος.
/office/clients: tab-code, tab-afm, tab-how, link-code-input, link-code-submit; active link row with level combobox + unlink-<id>; pending AFM row for ANYHOW ΙΚΕ.
/office/clients/<orgId> renders client360-kpis; unknown UUID → HTTP 404 (Η σελίδα δεν βρέθηκε).
/office/vat: vat-month-input, vat-bulk-transmit, vat-bulk-export, vat-table, vat-row-<orgId>, vat-select-<orgId>.
/office/fees: fee-row-<orgId>, fee-amount-<orgId>, fee-cadence-<orgId>, fee-note-<orgId>, fee-save-<orgId>, fees-generate-btn, fees-clients, fees-charges.
/office/assistant: assistant-run → LLM (POST /api/copilot/office-brief) returns Greek Σύνοψη + 6 Ενέργειες σήμερα with severity badges + per-client breakdown in ~25s.
Business regression: /dashboard renders; /settings?tab=users role dropdown contains no 'accountant' role.
action_items: (NAMING / LOW) Align testids to the documented spec — either add duplicate aliases or update docs. Preferred: keep per-orgId ids for fees (better for table interactions) and update the spec; add vat-bulk-books as an alias on the export button.

(SEED / MEDIUM) Provide a scenario where the accountant has a pending business-invite (status='pending' firmLinkInvites row) so future testing can visually assert org-invite-accept-<id> / org-invite-decline-<id>. Currently only the outbound-from-business path is testable end-to-end because the receiver is already linked.

(LOW) Consider a POST-based /logout route or a data-testid on the sign-out anchor — Playwright cannot easily switch users mid-run (GET /logout kept the session and any subsequent goto('/login') server-redirected to /dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: resolveFirm/firmClients gate every /office/* server component; the 404 fallback on /office/clients/<orgId> for non-linked orgs is enforced server-side. Good.
AccountantAccessPanel uses server actions with useTransition and toast feedback — good UX; state (currentCode/level) is optimistically updated after action success.
FeesPanel per-row testids (fee-<field>-<orgId>) are the correct pattern for CRUD tables, but the review-request-listed bare ids should be documented consistently.
The office AI brief endpoint returns quickly (~25s including LLM streaming); the UI blocks on assistant-run until [data-testid=assistant-result] mounts — no error state was observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (13/13 verified). 1 flow (business→accountant invite receiver-side) blocked by seed state.

test_credentials: demo@timologio.gr / demo1234 (business owner); office@koletsas.gr / office1234 (accounting firm owner).
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally. During the run a 6-digit code was generated (948730), and the existing active link's access level was toggled to μόνο ανάγνωση — main agent may want to reset it to 'full' before demoing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All accountant/office testids exist and are functional. Key naming: use [data-testid="vat-bulk-export"] (not vat-bulk-books) and fee-*-<orgId> per-row (not bare fee-*). For playwright login, use `async with page.expect_navigation(): await page.click('button[type=submit]')` — plain networkidle sometimes returns before the server-side redirect resolves. /logout does NOT clear the cookie (GET). To switch users you must clear cookies via browser context. Accountant has 1 active link (Δήμος Παπαδόπουλος, orgId fa82eab8-ce41-4d73-8a3f-05a0f63f1002) and 1 pending AFM request (ANYHOW ΙΚΕ).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects blocking release. Only two low-severity docs/naming deltas and one seed-state limitation preventing full org-invite receiver-side visual verification.
